latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate, edit, and export AI-driven videos in your browser via cloud rendering.

- Instantly generate 30-second promotional videos from text prompts or uploaded clips.
- Upload MP4, MOV, WebM, or GIF files up to 500MB; AI handles video generation and editing.
- Simple onboarding: automatic token creation, session handling, and guided status notifications.
- Full workflow support: upload media, edit timeline, preview changes, and export in common formats.
- Designed for marketers and content creators—no need to install software or learn complex editors.
